name: Foreboding
description: Patrol tokens in sight display their pursuit vector when committed to a hunt.

name: Retrace
description: Undo the party's last movement step: position restored, step refunded. Once per expedition, hard cap.

name: Auspice
description: Preview the corruption's next ground: nearby clean tiles pressed by corrupted neighbours are marked.

name: Stasis Snare
description: Freeze one visible patrol in place for the party's next 6 steps. Delay, not removal.
